name: Raff
description: Raff Capashen is a young illusionist and ship's mage of the Weatherlight crew, Danitha Capashen's younger brother and a student of the Tolarian Academy.

bio.text: A thirteen-year-old junior at the Tolarian Academy, he caught Jhoira's attention as a skilled navigator.

bio.text: He volunteered to go in his sister's place, and Jhoira recruited him after he created an illusion of the original Weatherlight.

timeline.summary: Raff Capashen volunteers to go in his sister's place.
timeline.quote: I'm a Capashen. I'm Raff.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira exposes Raff's lie about Jodah.
timeline.quote: Jodah did not say that.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Raff shows his skill by creating an illusion of the original Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: In the distance the original version of the Weatherlight angled across the sky.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira recruits Raff.
timeline.quote: If you want to come, pack hurriedly.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Raff notices a vampire waiting with Tiana.
timeline.quote: Why does she have a vampire with her?

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Raff suggests Tolaria West, where Cabal agents are rumored.
timeline.quote: The last time I was in Tolaria West, there were rumors about Cabal agents in the academy.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Shanna argues the killings are not how Cabal agents operate.
timeline.quote: I've hunted Cabal agents in the cities of Jamuraa, and this is not how they operate.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Raff offers a forbidden spell to draw out the agent's thoughts.
timeline.quote: It involves drawing individual thoughts out of someone's brain.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira says she knows a time mage who can help.
timeline.quote: But I know just the time mage who can.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: The group escapes as sand floods the well and the Weatherlight drops ladders.
timeline.quote: The plateau is sinking.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Raff identifies Slimefoot as a thallid that probably came aboard as a spore on the tree elemental seed Jhoira used, and notes it already has about ten babies.
timeline.quote: This one probably came aboard as a spore, stuck to that tree elemental seed Jhoira used to regrow the hull.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Tiana decides to leave the thallids where they are while she goes to speak to Jhoira.
timeline.quote: Right, let's just leave it where it is right now. I'm going to talk to Jhoira.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Raff casts an illusion that gives Chandra a sword scar for her Cabal bounty hunter disguise.
timeline.quote: Her skin puckered and pulled, creating a sword scar that ran from one side of her forehead to her jaw.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Yargle grips the Weatherlight's bow and tosses the ship about while the crew fights it and Liliana struggles to hold her undead army.
timeline.quote: The purple bolts slid across Yargle's slimy skin with no effect.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Urgoros rises from the volcano on a dragon-like mount to attack the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: I think that's Urgoros!

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Ajani digs Karn out of the cave-in, explaining Jhoira had a tracking spell on her letters, and tells Karn he has been buried for months.
timeline.quote: She asked Raff to place a tracking spell on the letters

citation.text: "Episode 2: Sand in the Hourglass" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: On the Weatherlight, Karn proposes forcing the Phyrexians into open war by baiting them with the sylex, the Mana Rig and himself; the group splits up to recruit allies.
timeline.quote: "We must force the Phyrexians into open warfare," Karn said

citation.text: "Episode 4: A Brutal Blow" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: A skeletal dragon attacks the Weatherlight, injuring Botono, and a lance tears a hole in the starboard wing.
timeline.quote: one of the lances from tearing a hole in the starboard wing

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: The crew finds the Weatherlight grounded in Otaria with cracked moderator rods, and Raff proposes seeking magic in the mountains.
timeline.quote: "I think that dragon was guarding something," Raff said.

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Shanna, Raff and Tiana find a smoky, magic-eating barrier, and Braids appears and offers help if they kill her shard-self.
timeline.quote: "I help you get inside the barricade, and you help me kill me."

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Braids opens four corridors in the barrier, and each of the three walks through alone.
timeline.quote: Four gaps had opened in the barrier, smooth sided and narrow.

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: The three emerge on the other side at different times and find the Phyrexian war construct sunk in a crater.
timeline.quote: the half-sunken hulk of a Phyrexian war machine

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Shard-Braids attacks the crew, Braids returns, and together they defeat the shard, which Braids absorbs.
timeline.quote: like an avalanche that buried the shard whole.

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Braids reveals she was holding the shard back, and Tiana starts gathering parts from the war construct.
timeline.quote: I think . . . I need to start gathering parts."

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Danitha refuses Jhoira's request to join the new Weatherlight crew; Raff goes in her stead.
timeline.quote: Danitha refused Jhoira 's request to become part of the new Weatherlight crew

citation.text: "Danitha Capashen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Josu Vess strikes Danitha with Whisper's blade at Blighted Fields; she and Raf feel the Legacy Curse.
timeline.quote: Josu struck her with Whisper 's blade

citation.text: "Danitha Capashen", section "Magic: Legends". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Whisper is defeated and Josu destroyed, Raf breaks the Legacy Curse with Whisper's dagger.
timeline.quote: Raf was able to use Whisper's dagger to break the curse afflicting the Capashen bloodline

citation.text: "Danitha Capashen", section "Magic: Legends". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Raff, a 13-year-old junior at the Tolarian Academy, catches Jhoira's attention as a skilled navigator.
timeline.quote: he was also a skilled navigator and caught

citation.text: "Raff Capashen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Raff offers to join the Weatherlight after Danitha refuses.
timeline.quote: Raff offered to join the Weatherlight after his sister Danitha refused that position.

citation.text: "Raff Capashen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Invasion, Raff helps smuggle information and supplies across Phyrexian-controlled territory.
timeline.quote: he has helped his crew smuggle valuable information and supplies

citation.text: "Raff Capashen", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Raff heals Teferi of a grave wound from a Phyrexian attack in the watchtower of New Argive.
timeline.quote: Raff healed Teferi of a grave wound inflicted during a Phyrexian attack

citation.text: "Raff Capashen", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Raff, Shanna Sisay and Tiana help free Braids before abandoning the Phyrexian-corrupted Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: helped to free Braids before their abandonment of the Weatherlight

citation.text: "Raff Capashen", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
